title: Equipment & Vehicle Loans Servicing Charges: Payment Order, Late Charges, Returned Payments and Nonaccrual
content:
For each Equipment & Vehicle Loans product, this table states the order in which an undesignated remittance is applied, the late-charge terms, the returned payment fee and the past-due threshold for nonaccrual.

## Payment application order

| Product | Order in which an undesignated remittance is applied |
|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | fees, then interest, then principal |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | interest, then principal, then fees |
| Used Equipment Loan | fees, then interest, then principal |
| New Equipment Loan | fees, then interest, then principal |
| Irrigation System Loan | fees, then interest, then principal |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | fees, then interest, then principal |

## Late charges, courtesy waivers, returned payments and nonaccrual

| Product | Late-charge percentage (% of the unpaid installment) | Minimum late charge (USD) | Maximum late charge (USD) | Late-charge grace period (calendar days) | Courtesy waivers per rolling 12 months | Returned payment fee (USD) | Nonaccrual threshold (calendar days past due) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | 5 | 25 | 150 | 10 | 1 | 30 | 90 |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | 5 | 25 | 500 | 15 | 0 | 30 | 90 |
| Used Equipment Loan | 5 | 25 | 500 | 15 | 1 | 30 | 90 |
| New Equipment Loan | 5 | 35 | 750 | 15 | 1 | 30 | 90 |
| Irrigation System Loan | 4 | 50 | 1000 | 15 | 1 | 30 | 90 |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | 4 | 50 | 1500 | 15 | 1 | 30 | 90 |

## Definitions

- **Payment application order** — the order in which an undesignated remittance is applied.
- **Late-charge percentage** — the late charge on an installment still not fully paid after the grace period, as a percentage of the unpaid installment.
- **Minimum late charge** — the minimum late charge per late installment, USD.
- **Maximum late charge** — the maximum late charge per late installment, USD.
- **Late-charge grace period** — the calendar days after an installment's due date before a late charge arises.
- **Courtesy waivers** — the late charges that may be waived as a courtesy on one loan in any rolling 12 months.
- **Returned payment fee** — the fee per payment returned unpaid by the member's bank, USD.
- **Nonaccrual threshold** — the calendar days an installment may stay unpaid past its due date before the loan is placed in nonaccrual.

## Notes on the schedule

- The EquipDirect Dealer Contract applies an undesignated remittance to interest first and to fees last; every other product applies it to fees first.
- The EquipDirect Dealer Contract allows 0 courtesy waivers: no late charge on that product is waived as a courtesy.
- The Truck & Trailer Loan has the shortest grace period, 10 calendar days, and the lowest maximum late charge, 150 USD.
